articles.summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. (NYSE: XRN) (the “Company” or “Chiron”) announced today that its Board of Directors has appointed Charles P. Fitzgerald as Chairman of the Board, effective immediately. Jeffrey Busch, the Company’s founder and outgoing Chairman, will remain a director following this transition. Mr. Fitzgerald has served as a director of Chiron since May 2026 and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Maewyn Capital Partners LLC (“Maewyn”), a Dallas-based investment firm focused on unlocking value across markets and cycles through both private real estate opportunities and select public real estate investments. In May 2026, Maewyn and its investment partners made a $100 million strategic investment in Chiron through a convertible perpetual preferred security designed to provide the Company with long-duration capital to support its growth and strategic transformation. articles.summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. (NYSE: XRN) (the “Company” or “Chiron”), announced today that it intends to release its third quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. The Company intends to hold a conference call to discuss those results the following day, Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Webcast Information Participants may access the call via live webcast by visiting the “Investor Relations” section of the Company's new website at www.chironre.com/investor/investor-overview/default.aspx . The Company encourages use of the webcast due to potential extended wait times to access the conference call via dial-in. Conference Call For those unable to access the webcast, participants should dial 1-800-717-1738 or 1-646-307-1865. Replay Information A replay of the call will be available from approximately 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on November 5, 2026, through 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on November 19, 2026.
